boundaries.peerCases: host validation only; never Rust decoder evidence
boundaries.causeCases: reject outcome and format-versus-actual-EOF attribution are separate; missing attribution blocks cause acceptance

fixtures.expectedOutput: synthetic source bytes, never C# decoder output

ownership.windows: unnamed Job with kill-on-close; child waits for assignment gate; inherited descendants must stay in Job
ownership.linux: fresh session; /proc session members; bounded kill of owned groups only
ownership.retainedTestArtifacts: source.zip, marker, observations, diagnostics and successful synthetic results remain for central inspection; host temporary directories must be absent
ownership.stopOn: timeout, unconfirmed worker/owned process exit, unexpected temporary residue, diagnostic failure; no next case

resultRules.pass: expected outcome plus exact preservation/tree/length/hash/CRC checks and observed injection; supervisor exit confirmation required
resultRules.blocked: unavailable injection, live link privilege failure or missing decoder cause attribution; never pass
resultRules.failure: unexpected error, timeout, crash, missing result, cleanup failure or mismatched output
resultRules.integrity: BudgetExceeded/EngineFailure/Timeout are not accepted as proof of ZIP format rejection
resultRules.list: ordered names/kinds/sizes/entry-index IDs and NotChecked verification; duplicate names remain visible
resultRules.sourcePosition: v1 List consumes its private input stream; v2 Extract restores initial position
resultRules.osPolicy: Windows case-fold/reserved/drive names blocked; Linux case-distinct/backslash/colon legal names preserved

centralCommands: 기존 승인 환경에서 새 폴더의 SHA256SUMS와 provenance origins gitBlob/sha256을 먼저 대조함.
중앙에서 config.example.json을 시험 소유 경로에 복사하고 실제 절대경로/바이너리/전체 산출물 해시 및 Rust lock 정보를 채움.
Windows에서는 기존 python 실행기 명령으로 동일 명령을 사용함. 양 OS의 bundle 바이트와 SHA256이 같아야 함.
신규 설치/복원 네트워크 접근은 이 계약으로 승인하지 않음. 기존 SDK/reference packs만 사용함.

performance.mode: --performance, fullAcceptance=true required; current seven unavailable conditions prevent acceptance
performance.elapsed: process launch through host CRC/path verification/publication/cleanup/exit; listing is an end-to-end startup proxy
performance.rss: 50ms concurrent process RSS sum; shared pages may be counted twice; not OS-independent absolute measure
performance.idle: one-shot worker N/A; future unchanged host idle requires stable no-job phase
performance.installedSize: measure installer/download bytes separately from installed app plus required runtimes, codecs, resources and notices; prerequisite-present/absent separately; no numbers generated
performance.limit: tiny regression corpus is not representative large-archive throughput

knownGates: cleanup.sequence24 unverified; reference contract preserved, not rerun
exact prepublication/real-output cancellation and concurrent publication barriers unavailable
decoder EOF versus format error not exposed separately by current host
runtime and Cargo.lock/dependency/license resolution remain central validation
supervisorNote: 강제 종료로 잔류를 없앴더라도 사례 통과로 세지 않음. fixture 작성도 외부 감독 자식에서 수행함.
